results.title: A Hermeneutical Study of “Śamatha and Vipaśyanā Focused on the ...
results.content: In the context of the SNS, _zongfa_ 總法 and _’dres pa’i chos_ should be understood as “combined teachings.” This is because, when referring to this form of _śamatha_ and _vipaśyanā_, it is explicitly stated that the Buddha’s teachings, such as the sutra collection, are gathered into one, united into one, summarized into one, and they form one aggregate.Footnote 14 Therefore, _dharma_ here simply refers to the Buddha’s teachings rather than other meanings; hence, I employ “teachings” to translate this term. Therefore, it becomes clear that before realizing suchness, an ordinary person must investigate and observe the meanings of the Buddha’s teachings to practice _śamatha_ and _vipaśyanā_ focused on the combined teachings, utilizing the mental factors: initial application of attention and sustained attention.
